svg.title: Compiler phases: overview
svg.desc: Read from top to bottom. CuTe traces symbolic calls. cuda.coop finalizes the provider bundle inside the CuTe hook. CuTe then compiles and links the kernel.

g.data-node: Python with symbolic values → typed IR
g.aria-label: CuTe compiler. Python with symbolic values → typed IR. CuTe traces the kernel and its control flow.. Cooperative calls emit IR during tracing.
g.text: Python with symbolic values → typed IR
CuTe traces the kernel and its control flow.
Cooperative calls emit IR during tracing.

g.data-node: Select the provider and its ABI
g.aria-label: cuda.coop. Select the provider and its ABI. Use value types, controls, and exact launch facts.. Use CUB. Derive the provider symbol.
g.text: Select the provider and its ABI
Use value types, controls, and exact launch facts.
Use CUB. Derive the provider symbol.

g.data-node: Emit symbolic calls; keep provider requests
g.aria-label: cuda.coop. Emit symbolic calls; keep provider requests. Each call names its provider before LTO-IR exists.. Keep distinct requests in the trace's session.. Record scratch uses with temporary operands when needed.
g.text: Emit symbolic calls; keep provider requests
Each call names its provider before LTO-IR exists.
Keep distinct requests in the trace's session.
Record scratch uses with temporary operands when needed.

svg.text: Tracing complete · finalize providers before kernel compilation

g.data-node: Compile or reuse the completed bundle
g.aria-label: cuda.coop. Compile or reuse the completed bundle. After tracing, render one C++ unit for the session.. On a cache miss, NVRTC returns provider LTO-IR.. The same program supplies any scratch layouts.
g.text: Compile or reuse the completed bundle
After tracing, render one C++ unit for the session.
On a cache miss, NVRTC returns provider LTO-IR.
The same program supplies any scratch layouts.

g.data-node: Resolve scratch; attach the provider link input
g.aria-label: cuda.coop. Resolve scratch; attach the provider link input. For deferred uses, apply the C++ sizes and alignments.. Allocate at kernel entry. Bind each call to its slice.. Attach the LTO-IR path to gpu.module link-libraries.
g.text: Resolve scratch; attach the provider link input
For deferred uses, apply the C++ sizes and alignments.
Allocate at kernel entry. Bind each call to its slice.
Attach the LTO-IR path to gpu.module link-libraries.

g.data-node: Completed kernel IR + provider LTO-IR → cubin
g.aria-label: CuTe compiler. Completed kernel IR + provider LTO-IR → cubin. Hash and build the module after the finalization hook.. Merge gpu.module link-libraries into LinkLibraries; compile.. nvJitLink resolves provider symbols. LTO can inline them.
g.text: Completed kernel IR + provider LTO-IR → cubin
Hash and build the module after the finalization hook.
Merge gpu.module link-libraries into LinkLibraries; compile.
nvJitLink resolves provider symbols. LTO can inline them.

g.data-node: Load the device binary; obtain the kernel entry
g.aria-label: CuTe compiler. Load the device binary; obtain the kernel entry. Launch the compiled kernel.. Reuse it on later calls.
g.text: Load the device binary; obtain the kernel entry
Launch the compiled kernel.
Reuse it on later calls.
